title.narrative: 23F - GAIN - Whey2Value - Greening the dairy sector in Pakistan

description.narrative: The two objectives of the project are; i) reduce the waste from cheese production by 44 million liters yearly and reduce pollution of this waste in local waterways, ii) transform the waste into a healthy and nutritious drink/food products and scale the opportunity that has been matured during the greening top up funding of the DMDP project GAIN Access to Better Dairy. Implement the matured business case with 5 local dairy companies to create significant new revenue streams, generate new jobs (business case indicate a good profit margin for a product price of 50% of milk), and iii) generate demand of the innovative affordable nutritious product among malnourished children using retail outlets as well distribution via social protection programs.
